title: scDCF: matched directionality analysis code for Supplementary Tables S7–S8
description: Analysis code for the matched 10%, 20%, 40% and 60% down-regulation experiments reported in Supplementary Tables S7–S8. Simulation uses R/Splatter. The archive contains the R generator and reference-method scorer, Python orchestration and evaluation, the scDCF source snapshot identified in provenance.json, reference metrics, environment requirements and validation notes. It excludes the historical Groups A–H benchmark, real-data analyses, generated matrices and cached scores. The analysis archive version is separate from the included scDCF package's historical version metadata. Full method scoring and clean-environment installation were not rerun during packaging; validation details are included in VALIDATION.txt.
